title: Search chats
summary: Finds a chat or group by name among the person's own chats, as they type. It never searches people outside the account's chats: Bipe has no directory (usernames.md).

results.description: Chats and groups whose name matches, in chat-list order. Empty while query is blank.

isSearching.description: true between a change of query and the first filtered result.

editQuery.effect: Sets query and the name filter, at most every 150 ms.

findByHandle.effect: When query starts with @ and has no result: opens the start-chat lookup with that handle (people issue).

close.effect: Clears query and goes back to the list.

notes: Filter: All of Joined, NonSpace, DeduplicateVersions and NormalizedMatchRoomName with the query. Both tabs together; each result shows whether it is a chat or a group.
No message search in this spec. Message text is end-to-end encrypted, so a message search needs a local index (later issue).
Requests and the self-chat are not in the results.
No results: bipe_app_search_no_results with the query. With a query that starts with @: bipe_app_search_find_handle opens findByHandle, with bipe_start_chat_search_by_handle as the footer.
Where search sits (ADR 0053): the search tab on iOS, the top bar on Android.
